facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 70°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Holland Meadows (4,930 ft) and Roaring River (4,960 ft) 43 to 50 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Holland Meadows
evidence.detail: left April 4; earlier seasons: May 29 (2023), May 17 (2024), May 2 (2025)

evidence.name: Roaring River
evidence.detail: left April 5; earlier seasons: May 28 (2023), May 25 (2024), May 20 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Holland Meadows (4,930 ft) and Roaring River (4,960 ft).

evidence.name: Holland Meadows
evidence.detail: 1.7 in on April 16; earlier seasons: 38.1 in (2023), 17.0 in (2024), 21.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Roaring River
evidence.detail: 1.3 in on April 17; earlier seasons: 40.9 in (2023), 25.9 in (2024), 34.0 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between February 13 and April 15, carried from the melt-out dates at Holland Meadows (4,930 ft) and Roaring River (4,960 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Holland Meadows
evidence.detail: melted out April 4, 1,157 ft above the pass; points to February 13 to April 14

evidence.name: Roaring River
evidence.detail: melted out April 5, 1,187 ft above the pass; points to February 13 to April 15
